parallel_delta_reconciled.assessment: Materially improves the oversize guard by bounding streamed/chunked reads to MaxPayloadBytes+1 instead of reading the entire body before rejecting. The delta is retained rather than reverted.

findings.evidence: The new bounded read loop handles requests without Content-Length, but the current oversized-payload regression sets ContentLength and therefore exercises only the early 413 branch.
findings.required_recovery: Add a controller regression with ContentLength absent and a body larger than 256 KiB; require HTTP 413 and zero persistence.
